name: Vice-principal
source:
He is a pushover and the vice principal of a respectable school. Inside, however, he is quite a snob, just a middle-aged perverted man.

He was the homeroom teacher when the main character Fusae was a student, and has lusted after Fusae quite a bit since then.

[From [url=http://www.cyc-soft.com/cyclet/cyclet_main.html]official site[/url]]
